name: guyub
description: Guyub dev tooling: Firebase emulators, security rules tests, demo seed

scripts.test: npm run test:functions && npm run test:rules && npm run test:smoke
scripts.test:smoke: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-guyub --only auth,firestore,functions "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/smoke/*.smoke.mjs"
